meta_title: Ocean City Plumbing | Emergency Plumber Plymouth
meta_description: Ocean City Plumbing is your trusted emergency plumber in Plymouth. Fast response times, no call-out fees, and 24/7 availability. Call now for help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Plymouth? We're here within the hour, day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle every plumbing challenge in your home or business.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Frozen or ruptured pipes? We isolate the problem, minimise water damage, and carry out permanent repairs on the same visit. Available 24/7 with no call-out charge.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Annual servicing prevents breakdowns, and our engineers diagnose faults fast to get you warm again.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots in your radiators? We bleed them, balance your system, or install new units to improve heat distribution and lower your bills.

services.title: Leaking Tap & Washer Repair
services.desc: A dripping tap wastes water and money. We replace worn washers and worn cartridges quickly, or fit new taps if repair isn't cost-effective.

services.title: Toilet Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Cistern issues, running water, or a cracked pan? We fix or replace toilets with minimal disruption, using durable fittings backed by warranty.

services.title: Pipe Repairs & Replacements
services.desc: Corroded, frozen, or leaking pipes? We locate the fault, repair or replace the section, and test the system to prevent future problems.

about_pullquote: We started this business because homeowners deserve honest, fair-priced plumbing without the wait.
about_para_1: Ocean City Plumbing was founded on a simple idea: show up fast, fix it right, charge fairly. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation by treating every emergency like it matters, because it does. When your boiler fails at midnight or a pipe bursts on Christmas Day, we're the team you can rely on.
about_para_2: Our engineers are fully trained and carry the parts they need on their vans, so most jobs finish the same day. We don't charge for the call-out, and we always give you a clear quote before we start. That's why Plymouth homeowners keep calling us back, and why we're proud of our 4.8-star rating.
reviews_heading: What Plymouth Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the kitchen at 11pm on a Saturday. Rang Ocean City and they were at my door by midnight. Fixed it in under an hour. No faffing about, fair price, absolutely brilliant. Wouldn't hesitate to call again.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: My radiators were ice cold but the engineer found the problem straight away — air lock in the system. Bled them all, tested the pressure, and I was warm by evening. No call-out fee either, which was a nice surprise. Really professional team.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in three days before Christmas. I thought I was done for, but Ocean City got an engineer out the same day. New part fitted, system working, all sorted. They've looked after us ever since. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: James P.
